title: Security Analyst learning roadmap
summary: A concise path to solidify fundamentals, learn core Security operations, create a showcase portfolio, and get ready for jobs. Tailored for someone with basic knowledge ready to start practical work.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Establish core networking and Linux knowledge essential for security work.

milestones.title: Networking fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Can explain TCP/IP, subnets, and common protocols used in attacks and defenses.

tasks.title: Read TCP/IP basics
tasks.description: Study the TCP/IP model and common ports on MDN networking guide.

tasks.title: Configure a home router
tasks.description: Log into your router, note its IP scheme, and set up a guest network.

tasks.title: Capture packets with Wireshark
tasks.description: Install Wireshark, capture traffic for 5 minutes, and identify HTTP requests.

tasks.title: Summarize key protocols
tasks.description: Write a one-page summary of DNS, HTTP, and SSH functions.

milestones.title: Linux Essentials
milestones.outcome: Can navigate the command line, manage files, and monitor system processes.

tasks.title: Complete Linux basics course
tasks.description: Finish the freeCodeCamp Linux fundamentals module.

tasks.title: Set up a virtual machine
tasks.description: Install Ubuntu Server in VirtualBox and boot it.

tasks.title: Practice common commands
tasks.description: Run ls, cat, grep, top, and chmod on sample files.

tasks.title: Configure SSH access
tasks.description: Generate SSH keys and enable password-less login to the VM.

tasks.title: Reflect on CLI experience
tasks.description: Write a short note on challenges and tips discovered.

phases.title: Core skills
phases.summary: Develop hands-on abilities in log analysis, SIEM usage, and incident response.

milestones.title: Log analysis basics
milestones.outcome: Can parse system logs and extract security-relevant events.

tasks.title: Read Linux syslog Guide
tasks.description: Study the syslog format on the official Linux Documentation Project.

tasks.title: Analyze auth logs
tasks.description: Use grep and awk to find failed login attempts in /var/log/auth.log.

tasks.title: Create a log parsing script
tasks.description: Write a Bash script that outputs timestamps of sudo usage.

tasks.title: Document findings
tasks.description: Summarize anomalies in a one-page report.

tasks.title: Join a log analysis forum
tasks.description: Introduce yourself on the r/loganalysis subreddit and ask a question.

milestones.title: SIEM tool proficiency
milestones.outcome: Can ingest data, build dashboards, and write basic detection rules.

tasks.title: Explore Elastic Stack docs
tasks.description: Read the official Elastic Stack quick start guide.

tasks.title: Install ELK on your VM
tasks.description: Set up Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana on the Ubuntu VM.

tasks.title: Ingest sample logs
tasks.description: Configure Logstash to pull Apache access logs into Elasticsearch.

tasks.title: Create a dashboard
tasks.description: Build a Kibana dashboard showing login failures over time.

tasks.title: Write a simple rule
tasks.description: Add a Watcher alert for >5 failed logins within 2 minutes.

milestones.title: Incident response fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Can follow a basic IR workflow from detection to containment.

tasks.title: Read NIST IR Guide
tasks.description: Study the NIST Computer Security Incident Handling Guide (PDF).

tasks.title: Simulate an alert
tasks.description: Generate a fake brute-force login event in your logs.

tasks.title: Document response steps
tasks.description: Write a step-by-step response plan for the simulated alert.

tasks.title: Conduct a post-mortem
tasks.description: Create a brief post-mortem report highlighting lessons learned.

tasks.title: Discuss with peers
tasks.description: Share your response plan on a security Discord channel for feedback.

phases.title: Proof of work
phases.summary: Create tangible projects that showcase your security analysis capabilities.

milestones.title: Home lab logging Project
milestones.outcome: A functional lab that collects, stores, and visualizes logs from multiple services.

tasks.title: Design lab architecture
tasks.description: Sketch a diagram of services, log sources, and ELK components.

tasks.title: Deploy services
tasks.description: Run Docker containers for Apache, SSH, and a vulnerable web app.

tasks.title: Configure log Forwarding
tasks.description: Set up Filebeat on each container to send logs to Logstash.

tasks.title: Build detection rules
tasks.description: Create three Kibana alerts for brute-force, web shell upload, and port scan.

tasks.title: Write Project Documentation
tasks.description: Compose a README with setup steps and findings.

milestones.title: CTF Incident report
milestones.outcome: A polished incident report demonstrating analysis and remediation.

tasks.title: Select a recent CTF challenge
tasks.description: Choose a publicly available CTF incident from CTFtime.

tasks.title: Recreate the scenario
tasks.description: Set up the vulnerable machine and trigger the exploit.

tasks.title: Collect evidence
tasks.description: Gather logs, network captures, and screenshots of the breach.

tasks.title: Write the report
tasks.description: Draft a 2-page report covering timeline, impact, and mitigation.

tasks.title: Peer review the report
tasks.description: Share the report with a security forum for critique.

milestones.title: Detection rule set
milestones.outcome: A reusable library of SIEM detection rules for common threats.

tasks.title: Identify common ATT&CK techniques
tasks.description: Select five techniques from MITRE ATT&CK relevant to enterprise environments.

tasks.title: Write rule templates
tasks.description: Create generic Elastic Watcher rules for each technique.

tasks.title: Test rules in lab
tasks.description: Generate simulated events to verify each rule fires correctly.

tasks.title: Document rule usage
tasks.description: Prepare a guide on how to customize and deploy the rules.

tasks.title: Publish on GitHub
tasks.description: Create a public repository and add a concise README.

phases.title: Getting ready
phases.summary: Advance knowledge, polish professional presence, and prepare for job or client engagements.

milestones.title: Threat intelligence basics
milestones.outcome: Can gather, analyze, and apply threat intel to detections.

tasks.title: Read MITRE ATT&CK overview
tasks.description: Study the ATT&CK matrix on the official MITRE site.

tasks.title: Subscribe to free feeds
tasks.description: Add AlienVault OTX and AbuseIPDB RSS feeds to your SIEM.

tasks.title: Create an intel brief
tasks.description: Write a one-page brief on a recent ransomware campaign.

tasks.title: Reflect on integration
tasks.description: Note how intel improved your detection rules.

tasks.title: Network with analysts
tasks.description: Attend a free virtual security meetup and introduce yourself.

milestones.title: Advanced SIEM techniques
milestones.outcome: Can build complex queries, automate alerts, and tune performance.

tasks.title: Learn KQL basics
tasks.description: Follow the Kibana Query Language tutorial on Elastic docs.

tasks.title: Write complex queries
tasks.description: Create a KQL query that correlates login failures with new user creation.

tasks.title: Automate alert responses
tasks.description: Set up a Watcher action that disables a user account via API.

tasks.title: Optimize index settings
tasks.description: Adjust Elasticsearch shard and replica settings for faster queries.

tasks.title: Share findings
tasks.description: Post a blog summary of your SIEM optimizations on Medium.

milestones.title: Job/client readiness
milestones.outcome: Prepared resume, interview answers, and professional brand for security analyst roles.

tasks.title: Update resume with projects
tasks.description: Add the home lab, CTF report, and rule set to your CV with metrics.

tasks.title: Craft an elevator pitch
tasks.description: Write a 30-second summary of your security expertise and practice aloud.

tasks.title: Mock Incident interview
tasks.description: Pair with a peer to simulate an IR scenario interview.

tasks.title: Gather references
tasks.description: Ask two mentors for written endorsements on LinkedIn.

tasks.title: Reflect on career goals
tasks.description: Write a short paragraph on the type of organization you aim to join.
